description: Judge a startup or side-project idea. Returns a verdict (verdict KILL, FIX or SHIP, shown as verdict_label KILL IT, FIX IT or SHIP IT), an overall score, the best_signal, the biggest_risk and the eight scored dimensions. If the idea is too vague to judge, needs_detail is true and verdict, verdict_label, score, best_signal and biggest_risk are null, and message says which details are missing. 10 Jev decisions in about a second. Deterministic rubric, no generated prose. The text result is a preformatted card with bar charts.

do_not_archive.description: When true, the idea text is not stored, for confidential ideas. Otherwise it is archived anonymously (no IP, no identity).

goal.description: Why the idea is being built, which decides the questions it is scored on. Making money judges it as a business. Open source scores Adoption instead of Money. Just for fun scores Immediate appeal and Fun instead of Real problem and Money.

idea.description: The idea in plain words: who it is for, what it does, how it makes money or spreads. More detail, better verdict.

name: judge_idea

best_signal.description: The highest-scoring dimension. null when needs_detail is true.

note.description: Fixed one-line comment on this strength.

biggest_risk.description: The lowest-scoring dimension. null when needs_detail is true.

note.description: Fixed one-line comment on this risk.

category.description: Product category Jev assigned to the idea.

dimensions.description: The scored questions for this goal, in display order.

question.description: What this dimension asks about the idea.

weight.description: Weight of this dimension in the overall score.

goal.description: The goal the idea was judged against.

judged_by.description: The model that judged the idea.

latency_ms.description: Time Jev took to answer, in milliseconds.

message.description: One-line summary such as "SHIP IT. 72/100.", or the request for more detail when needs_detail is true.

needs_detail.description: True when Jev could not understand the idea well enough to judge it: no verdict, score or signals are given, and message says which details are missing.

score.description: Overall score: weighted average of the dimension scores, rounded. null when needs_detail is true.

scoring_version.description: Version of the questions, weights and thresholds used.

try_it.description: Link to the Kill My Idea website.

verdict.description: Verdict code from the score and the thresholds below. null when needs_detail is true.

verdict_label.description: Display form of the verdict, e.g. "KILL IT". null when needs_detail is true.

title: Judge a startup idea
